critiques.issue: E027 was kept in breach of its own pre-registered rule. The rule required seeds 0–2 ≥ 0.753 and a held-out mean ≥ 0.7535. The held-out mean came in at 0.7526, below both 0.7535 and the 0.753 bar. Seeds 0–2 (0.7547) read about 0.2 pp lucky. So the tip is feasible only by the luck of the seed draw. If a recipe sits at a 0.7525 population mean and the seeds 0–2 offset has an SD of about 0.3 pp (E016 +0.43, E017 −0.40, E027 +0.21), it passes the 3-seed bar only about 45% of the time. E028 then failed that same lottery with an identical population mean. The loop is now picking between equivalent recipes by coin flip.
critiques.suggestion: Log E027 as kept against its rule. For future keeps, require a held-out mean of at least about 0.7545–0.755, so the seeds 0–2 bar is passed with roughly 70–85% probability, instead of setting the threshold at the bar. Spend that margin on the freeze lever (E028) rather than on epoch trims.

critiques.issue: The best result in the loop is still marked 'open'. E028 gave −0.52 s (−8.8%) at −0.01 pp held-out, yet H2.6.1 shows E028+ with status open and confidence 0.15. The accuracy equivalence rests on one 10-seed comparison (SE of the difference about 0.11 pp). E028 also changed two things: the group-1/whitening LR schedule was re-annealed to 0 by 75%, and the backward was truncated. Which one is accuracy-neutral is not identified.
critiques.suggestion: Mark H2.6.1 supported for time and provisionally supported for accuracy. Next run: E028's freeze plus 0.25–0.5 true epoch on top of E027, with a predicted time of about 5.5–5.65 s and a held-out mean of about 0.754–0.756. After that, map the dose: freeze start at 0.6/0.65, and freeze group 2 for the last 10%. Replicate the best one on seeds 13–22.

critiques.issue: No Lvl1 explains E028's time saving. Freezing group 1 cut about 27% of a 32 px step, although group 1 is about 20% of conv MACs and the estimate was 14–18%. The notebook's explanation is memory-bound BN/GELU backward on the largest maps. That contradicts how H6 is framed: H6 says the inefficiency sits in small maps and tensor-core use. E028 points to bandwidth-bound elementwise work on large maps. E011's '95% pixel-proportional' model cannot tell the two apart, because memory traffic also scales with pixels. H2.2.4, H6.1.1 and H6.2.1 (profiling) have been open since about E017 and were never run, although each costs minutes.
critiques.suggestion: Run one torch.profiler trace per resolution on the tip now. Split the time per layer into conv GEMM time and elementwise BN/GELU/pool time, for forward and backward. Rewrite H6 around the measured split. If elementwise traffic is large, test the levers that follow: fused BN+GELU, fp16 activations kept for backward, group-1 narrowing, or dropping group 1's third conv (H2.5.2, never run).

structured_output.summary:
The loop's biggest strategic error is that it keeps recipes whose population accuracy sits at the 0.753 bar, and then reads 3-seed outcomes that are effectively coin flips. The tip, E027, was kept against its own pre-registered held-out rule (0.7526 < 0.7535). E028's FreezeOut matched that population accuracy, saved 0.52 s, and was discarded on the same lottery. The clear next move is E028's freeze plus 0.25–0.5 epoch, with keeps gated on a held-out mean of about 0.7545 or more.

E028 is also the most surprising result and is unexplained by any Lvl1. Its 27% per-step saving points to bandwidth-bound backward on the large maps, while H6 frames the inefficiency as small maps and tensor cores. The profiling hypotheses (H2.2.4, H6.1.1, H6.2.1) have been open for about 13 experiments and should run now.

Several 'established' facts rest on evidence the loop itself has declared uninterpretable:
- The flat scalars (LS, Muon lr, LR floor) and the 512-width cut rest on 3-seed differences of 0.04–0.25 pp.
- H5 and H1.2 rest on a single confounded run, E006.
- E005's 'every seed gained' argument contradicts H4.1(c).
- 'H1.3 is closed' rests on two roughly 2.3σ single comparisons, while BN-stat recompute and plain EMA were never tried.

The held-out seeds 3–12 have been reused for about 10 decisions, and the fresh-seed replicate (H4.3.2) has never run.

Bookkeeping is inconsistent:
- H1.6.1, H1.3.7 and H2.6.1 have stale statuses.
- H2.3 is marked supported with three refutes in its evidence column.
- H4.1.2 is supported despite violations.
- H1 cites a 59.3 s baseline that is not in the results.

Directions never tried: the Muon ablation, batch size per phase, the group-1 architecture cut, prepare-time trimming (now about 2% of the run, comparable to current levers), and augmentation changes.
